answer: Agents register identities through a zero-knowledge SGX/TPM attestation of a measured policy; the vault is the bonded identity state tree, dune is its hash anchor, and glacier is the consensus slashing contract. Forging an identity requires controlling a distinct attested enclave and physically provisioning silicon, then repeating VDF proofs. A quadratic bonding curve charges O(N^2) capital across N identities, while equivocation irreversibly slashes collateral.
